title: Lead / Outreach Record
description: One record per prospect for either sales track: copywriting client acquisition or agent-service self-promotion (system prompt §4 and §5).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the prospect's business, used to gate Module 4 outreach against config/platforms.json growth_agent.approved_outreach_countries (ai-automation-client track).

email_source.description: How the email was obtained (ai-automation-client track). Never a value implying social-platform scraping — see docs/growth-agent/data-sourcing-policy.md. A record with no valid email_source does not proceed past Module 1.

signals.description: weak_copy_examples for copywriting track, pain_signals for agent-service track.

audit_brief.description: Client Diagnostics Brief from prompts/growth-agent/business-audit.md (ai-automation-client track only). See docs/growth-agent/architecture.md Module 2.

solution_blueprint.description: Output of prompts/growth-agent/solution-blueprint.md (ai-automation-client track only). See docs/growth-agent/architecture.md Module 3.

hook_breakdown.description: Per-line personalization justification for outreach_draft, shown to the human alongside the draft per the Intercept Rule (GROWTH_AGENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md Module 4).
